sentences.en: When you are driving, you should make way for ambulances.
sentences.zh: 当你开车时，你应该给救护车让路。

sentences.en: The rain made it impossible for me to drive fast.
sentences.zh: 雨使得我无法快速驾驶。

sentences.en: I must make up for lost time by driving fast.
sentences.zh: 为了弥补失去的时间，我必须开快点。

senses.zh: 驱赶驱使, 促使敲, 击
